title: Collapsible test case detail pane
requirement: The test-cases detail pane must be collapsible so the case list can use the full panel width when detail is not needed.
reason: Interactive layout requirement; implemented UI proof is pending.
steps: Open Tasks → Test cases with a case selected.
Confirm the list becomes wider and remains usable.
Show detail again and confirm the same case and filters return.
expected: The detail pane can be hidden, the list expands to the available width, and showing detail restores the selected case without losing filters or scroll position.

history.notes: Observed in the real Tasks → Test cases panel; usability-proof.mjs exit 0
